storyCards.fact:
Kid Rock's "All Summer Long" reached #23 on the Billboard Hot 100. "All Summer Long" is a song by American recording artist Kid Rock.

The song peaked at #23 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.
